window: Entire existing frozen evaluation window; no new date/threshold selection
semantics: Both mocks use identical effective Safe policy/entry-only day cap/global120min entry pause/fee-inclusive stop basis; strategy exits uncapped. Default Rule reference retains its actual distinct role semantics, stated explicitly.
syntheticExecution: Fixed-spread quotes at execution-bar open, assumed one-level1000quote depth at nominal+5s. No observed historical depth/queue/receipt/latency. Only closed earlier candles and hourly aggregates in provider inputs.
comparison: Net return/drawdown/closed-trade mean realized PnL/win rate/profit factor/entry frequency/weekly chronological carry-position slices. Null if not meaningful. Same-fill fee drag algebra shown separately from adaptive rerun.
noSelection: No model training, parameter search, post-test retuning, calibrated probability, independent sample count or prospective profitability claim. Existing history is consumed.
sourceInputChecks: Compare exogenous feature/quote/structure/cost fingerprints on shared decision times across both policy paths. Paused paths may have different decision times.
baselineReferences: Cash0 and terminal fee-inclusive BTC approximation; Rule reference at same scenario assumptions but with original Rule execution semantics. Original frozen default data/options/report not overwritten.
